scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:cloudflare && pnpm --filter @vibeflare/worker exec wrangler deploy --config ../../wrangler.toml
scripts.release:gate: pnpm build:all && pnpm validate:wrangler && pnpm validate:deploy-button && pnpm security:audit && pnpm notices:check && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @vibeflare/ui test:e2e
scripts.db:migrate:cloudflare: pnpm --filter @vibeflare/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config ../../wrangler.toml
scripts.validate:deploy-button: bun tools/validate-deploy-button.ts && pnpm --filter @vibeflare/worker exec wrangler deploy --config ../../wrangler.toml --dry-run --outdir ../../.wrangler/deploy-button-dry-run
